purpose: Offline diagnostic residual counterfactuals; not trained candidates or a production postprocessor

flat32.guidance: constant zero, matched window and operator control

mean_policy: Restore original per-channel global mean residual before clipping
boundaries: Reflect padding for uniform window statistics, full native image before cropping
selection_policy: No checkpoint selection. Inspect contour/edge/detail/colour/clipping tradeoffs on these fixed diagnostic cases. No training or held-out access. Parameter values fixed before running this pilot.
